text: The task opens one forward compose window and obtains its editor body. It checks innerText and textContent on that same element. The two messages call these plain-text and HTML bodies, but the task does not open two composition modes. Name the DOM property results directly to keep assertion diagnostics within actual coverage. Attachment count/name are separate direct checks. No alternate-mode or compose execution ran.
title: The attachment-only forward test checks two text properties of one compose body
